notes: v3.64.31 (Dot 2 don gian hoa phan quyen - Sep: code, da duyet du bang qua nhieu lan ra soat Excel). ROLE_TIERS mo rong tu 7 len 9 (them nv_ke_toan, quan_ly_cty_con), danh so lai dung bang chot. Ham moi _roleTierPerm(flag) - suy luan dung bang Vai tro x Module da chot (Truong bo phan: canSignHr neu HR, canCheckAcc+canApproveL1+canConfirmPayment neu TCKT, KHONG canApproveL2/canManageUsers/isPayrollAcc; NV Ke toan: canCheckAcc; NV nhan su luong: isPayrollAcc; Quan ly cty con: canCheckAcc+canApproveL1; CEO: tat ca; Tau/Thu kho: null - giu nguyen co che cu). Gan vao 6 ham quyen loi (canSignHr/canManageUsers/canConfirmPayment/canApproveL1/canApproveL2/canCheckAcc) + isPayrollAdmin(). setUserRoleTier() gio tu bundling isDeptHead=true khi truong_bp, isCEO=true khi ceo - moi noi dang doc thang CURRENT_USER.isDeptHead (dataScope, _tmCanPerf...) tu dong dung, khong can sua tung cho. Tai khoan CHUA gan Vai tro (_roleTierPerm tra null) van chay dung y het co cu, khong ai bi doi quyen ngoai y muon.
